pcvs.name: vR
pcvs.expression: sum over layers where the net has a route polygon or route cut rectangle of the vertices of the pins initNet builds there (merge of route and fixed polygon sets, plus 4 per cut rectangle)

pcvs.name: vF
pcvs.expression: the same sum over layers where the net has only fixed shapes

pcvs.name: layers
pcvs.expression: layers where the net has any shape

pcvs.name: nlogn
pcvs.expression: sum over those layers of n*log2(n), n = rectangles added there (fixed and route polygons, cut rectangles)

factors.criterion: work per pin vertex, with fixed shapes costing more than route shapes because the fixed polygons are re-extracted by three passes (fixed-edge set, fixed-vertex cache, get_max_rectangles over the fixed set)
layers holding only fixed shapes as a separate term (their pins are all fixed)
per-layer cost of the passes on layers with shapes; a sorting term (n log n) for polygon-set cleaning and ordered sets

fix.effect: vF coefficient falls about 3.5x (all-fixed shortcut), vR about 14%, per-net constant halves

drperf.units: instructions per region call; [formula, unexplained percent]; small_formula_at_large in percent of the measured large total

historical.formula: edges on obstruction nets 1,700*verts + 20,984 -> 431*verts + 4,478; corners 1,677*verts + 7,219 -> 463*verts + 2,896; DRC setup 41.3e9 -> 23.6e9 instructions (steps 1-3)

grading: Semantic review against the record and code, not keyword matching. Equivalent expressions and well-supported alternative decompositions count. Coefficients are measured on this build and machine and are not acceptance thresholds.
scope: The case's scenario at the listed sizes on the standalone extraction; not an all-input guarantee and not a claim about OpenROAD's full router.
